method: The workflow source was traced to the G.14.6 functions it calls. A control is OFFLINE_INTEGRATION_VERIFIED only when a G.14.7 test drives AcquisitionWorkflow.run or a declare_* method into that function and observes the failure or the completion. A mock transport alone is not verification.

controls.control: Only ScriptedTransport is accepted. None and any other type fail closed.

controls.code: authorize_url called from _validate_policy and authorize_redirect_chain called from _request
controls.control: Scheme, host, port, userinfo, path, and role are checked before each exchange.
controls.negative: unapproved index and unapproved artifact host
controls.bypass: none found; the scripted transport cannot skip the call

controls.control: Each location is authorized before the next exchange. Downgrade, third host, and excess hops fail closed.
controls.positive: one same-host redirect in the end-to-end run
controls.bypass: none found; ScriptedTransport.exchange does not follow locations

controls.control: Source distributions, yanked releases, prereleases, and non-any tags are rejected before fetch.
Chunk, artifact, cumulative, header, timeout-field, retry, status, content type, and length checks.
controls.negative: oversized_response, truncated_response, interrupted_stream, timeout, retry_exhausted, unexpected_status
controls.bypass: limits apply to SyntheticResponse fields, not to a socket reader

controls.control: Post-open creates use NtCreateFile on the opened directory. Reparse handles are rejected.
controls.positive: end-to-end create; parent replacement left the substitute directory empty
controls.negative: junction, injected reparse, hard link, short write, prohibited paths
controls.bypass: the first CreateFileW is still a path lookup

controls.control: Hash, size, ZIP, WHEEL, METADATA, and RECORD must match before the lock is written.
controls.negative: hash_mismatch, size_mismatch, malformed_zip, missing_wheel_metadata, missing_metadata, missing_record, manifest tamper
controls.bypass: none found on the workflow path; path-based verify_wheelhouse is not used for completion
declare_graph and declare_lock from the wrong state fail illegal_transition

controls.control: Lock is written only after verification. Provenance is SYNTHETIC_TEST_ONLY. source_approved is false.
controls.negative: false_completion_claim for non-synthetic provenance; no lock after failed verification

controls.control: States move only in order. Failures become FAILED_CLOSED.
controls.positive: COMPLETE_SYNTHETIC only after the lock evidence exists
controls.negative: declare_fetch, declare_verified, declare_graph, declare_lock, declare_complete from CREATED

high_findings: INITIAL_PATH_LOOKUP_NOT_ATOMIC: the parent directory is still opened by path
medium_findings: Directory symlink creation returned errno 22 and those OS cases were not executed
Timeout and retry limits are fields on the synthetic response, not operating-system enforcement
